mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, title, subtitle, cover_url, anchor_name, anchor_id, live_type, provider_code, stream_name, watch_url, comment_enabled, share_enabled, scheduled_start_time, scheduled_end_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, stop_reason, status, viewer_count, heat_count, sort_order, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_live_room WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM dms_live_room WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_live_room WHERE stream_name=#{streamName} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM dms_live_room WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status IN (1,2,3) ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 2 THEN 0 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE WHEN status=1 THEN scheduled_start_time END ASC, sort_order DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_live_room SET title=#{title},subtitle=#{subtitle},cover_url=#{coverUrl}, anchor_name=#{anchorName},anchor_id=#{anchorId},live_type=#{liveType},provider_code=#{providerCode}, stream_name=#{streamName},watch_url=#{watchUrl},comment_enabled=#{commentEnabled}, share_enabled=#{shareEnabled},scheduled_start_time=#{scheduledStartTime}, scheduled_end_time=#{scheduledEndTime},status=#{status},viewer_count=#{viewerCount}, heat_count=#{heatCount},sort_order=#{sortOrder},version=version+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE dms_live_room SET actual_start_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status=2 AND actual_start_time IS NULL
UPDATE dms_live_room SET status=3,actual_end_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status=2
UPDATE dms_live_room SET status=#{status},version=version+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dms_live_room_product WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND live_room_id=#{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_live_anchor WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM dms_live_anchor WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_live_anchor WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_user_id=#{memberUserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_live_anchor SET status=#{status},version=version+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
UPDATE dms_live_anchor SET last_live_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_live_comment SET status=#{status},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}

UPDATE dms_live_view_session SET user_id=COALESCE(#{userId},user_id), last_seen_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,duration_seconds=GREATEST(duration_seconds,#{durationSeconds}), update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND live_room_id=#{roomId} AND visitor_id=#{visitorId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS roomId,r.title AS roomTitle, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_live_view_session v WHERE v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.live_room_id=r.id) AS uniqueViewers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_live_view_session v WHERE v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.live_room_id=r.id AND v.last_seen_time >= #{activeSince}) AS currentViewers, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(v.duration_seconds)) FROM dms_live_view_session v WHERE v.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND v.live_room_id=r.id),0) AS averageDurationSeconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_live_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND e.live_room_id=r.id AND e.event_type='SHARE') AS shareCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_live_comment c WHERE c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.live_room_id=r.id AND c.status=1) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_live_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND e.live_room_id=r.id AND e.event_type='PRODUCT_CLICK') AS productClickCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_shop_order o WHERE o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.source_live_room_id=r.id AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL) AS paidOrderCount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM dms_shop_order o WHERE o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.source_live_room_id=r.id AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL),0) AS paidAmount FROM dms_live_room r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{roomId}
